chunks: The grave robber, if he is known for doing that, is to have his hand cut off.

key_terms.النَّبَّاشُ: the grave robber; one who exhumes graves for theft
key_terms.بِذَٰلِكَ: for that act, meaning grave robbing
key_terms.قُطِعَ: his hand is cut off; the prescribed legal punishment is carried out

ai.seo_question: What is the legal punishment for a grave robber in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the grave robber who is known for repeatedly committing that act. It indicates that habitual and established commission of grave robbery carries the hadd punishment of amputation.
